entities.summary: Kanuri, a notable figure in the history of Niger, associated with Trans-Saharan Trade and Early States (700–1400). Preceded by Kanem-Bornu Influence in Eastern Niger. Their legacy influenced Agadez Sultanate Founded 1449 and Agadez Sultanate Origins.
